summary.intent: Fix apps/validate's RDT oracle crash under typescript^7, build a TS-API-based semantic parity probe, re-verify accuracy Evidence against the full fixture corpus (docs/type-checker-integration.md steps 1-3), then investigate and land a large pile of unrelated pending doc/config changes discovered in the working tree, and reshape ADR formatting guidance.
summary.outcome: RDT oracle fixed via a typescript-next aliased dependency (RDT stays on typescript@6.0.3, semantic probe uses typescript-next@7.1.0-dev); run-semantic.ts and parity.ts were built, lint/format-clean, and re-verified (99.7% required-match, 95.3% type-string-match across 44 files/47 components/5554 props). Traced and landed the unrelated pending pile as three more commits (AGENTS.md/ADR/prose cleanup, semantic-model relocation to docs/architecture, per-tool Entire CLI hooks/skill mirrors), then relaxed the ADR Decision-section rule and refreshed docs/STATUS.md.

repo: apps/validate has no output-abstraction convention (unlike crates/cli's AGENTS.md rule to avoid println!) — plain console.log/console.error is the established pattern across baseline.ts, compare.ts, analyze.ts, run-react-docgen-typescript.ts

pnpm-workspace `overrides` for a peer dependency gets recorded in the lockfile but does not actually rewrite the resolved peer version in node_modules — had to use an aliased dependency (typescript-next: npm:typescript@next) instead
typescript@next (7.x) ships a new async Program/Checker API at 'typescript/unstable/async' (class-based, not raw JSON-RPC); SyntaxKind lives separately in 'typescript/unstable/ast'
RDT 2.4.0 crashes on import against typescript@7 because ts.JsxEmit is undefined in that version's API surface
docs/adr/README.md defines house style (banned words like leverage/utilize/robust, sentence-case headers, active voice, cut filler) that should apply repo-wide, not just to ADRs

This repo's cross-tool agent convention (from a sibling project 'agent-plugins' and inspired by callisto) is: AGENTS.md replaces CLAUDE.md as the shared doc, with .agents/.codex/.cursor/.gemini/.github/hooks/.github/skills holding per-tool mirrors of .claude/ hooks and skills

callisto's precedent: model/architecture docs should live in docs/architecture/ (not .claude/) so every agent tool can read them — this repo followed that pattern, moving .claude/semantic-model/ to docs/architecture/

docs/archive/ is this repo's convention for retiring stale planning/handoff docs, with a README index noting why each was archived — archived docs' own internal content/paths are never rewritten (treated like git history)
.claude/skills/entire-search/SKILL.md is marked ENTIRE-MANAGED and auto-synced by the entire CLI tool — must not be hand-edited

code.finding: typescript pinned to ^6.0.3 for RDT; typescript-next added as npm:typescript@next alias for the semantic probe

New file implementing RDT's extraction algorithm via typescript@next's async Checker API; refactored to Promise.all-based parallelism to satisfy oxlint's no-await-in-loop, and added literal-union extraction matching RDT's shouldExtractLiteralValuesFromEnum behavior
New file diffing run-semantic.ts output against the RDT baseline; wired into `pnpm parity`, uses chalk for summary coloring
Decision section rule relaxed from mandatory one-paragraph to 'shape should match the decision' (paragraph, or paragraph plus bullets)

workflow: Used `entire search`/`entire checkpoint explain` to trace which prior session/prompt produced a pile of uncommitted changes when git history alone didn't explain it
When uncommitted changes could stem from multiple sessions, cross-reference session timestamps and commit history to rule out unrelated already-landed work before attributing to the real source

Parallel background agents (Agent tool) used to audit/clean prose across independent doc groups (root docs, ADRs, topic docs, semantic-model move) simultaneously, each reporting back via teammate messages with no git commits, letting the orchestrating session verify and commit centrally
Verified a refactor's correctness by diffing normalized JSON output (sorted keys, zeroed volatile fields) between pre- and post-refactor runs before overwriting the committed baseline
Split unrelated work into separate logical commits even when discovered together: oracle-fix, AGENTS.md/ADR/prose cleanup, semantic-model move, and tool-config hooks/skills each got their own commit

friction: pnpm-workspace `overrides` silently failed to rewrite RDT's peer typescript resolution despite being recorded in the lockfile, requiring multiple rounds of node_modules/lockfile wipes and a different approach (aliased dependency)
typescript@next's async API is undocumented/unstable (no clear docs), requiring reading compiled dist/api/async/api.js source directly to discover the Checker/Symbol/Type wrapper class methods
SyntaxKind not re-exported from 'typescript/unstable/async', causing an initial smoke-test failure until imported from 'typescript/unstable/ast' instead

Determining the true source of a large uncommitted change pile required significant investigative work (entire search/checkpoint explain across multiple candidate sessions) since git history and file diffs alone were ambiguous
open_items: Rust client for the Lifecycle gate (step 4 of docs/type-checker-integration.md) — explicitly deferred per user's 'stop before step 4' instruction, user later said 'start' but no work shown yet in transcript

Lifecycle gate still needs: missing-binary handling, unsupported-version detection, timeout/crash/restart-storm handling, malformed/oversized frame handling, partial-project failure, shutdown reaping, stale-notification handling — all 'not started' per Gates table

rdt-compat/svg-icon.tsx has a genuine RDT bug (multiple forwardRef in one file causes cross-contamination of element types between components) — documented but not fixed, since RDT is only the oracle, not shipped code
